chapter: Playing the bass in New Orleans
title: Bowing and picking the bass, Pig Ankle, Lulu White and country dances
summary: He explains bowing and picking the bass, names Johnny Prudence as the first picker, then lists clubs: the Pig Ankle on Franklin, Lulu White's after-hours dances, Antoine's, and country jobs for the Nunez brothers and Delacroix Island.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
